name: requirements-impact-refiner
description: Refines software requirements by exposing repository-backed change impacts and regression risks before planning.

interface.longDescription: Reuse a trustworthy previous impact report when available, discover affected behavior, preserve invariants, and reduce or explicitly accept regression risks before implementation planning.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this change's impact before planning it.
Refine this requirement without breaking existing behavior.
Show the previous impact report for this change, then revalidate only if needed.
